name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for engineering, fueled by his father's work as a mechanical engineer. He excelled in university, earning a degree in mechanical engineering with a specialization in aerodynamics. He quickly found a role at a smaller racing outfit, where he honed his skills in vehicle dynamics and data analysis. His passion for innovation and pushing boundaries quickly led him to lead the technical department. 

Krzysztof is known for his methodical approach and ability to integrate cutting-edge technology into practical solutions. He emphasizes collaboration and open communication within his team, fostering an environment where new ideas can flourish. He aims to transform Williams into a leading force in the sport through relentless innovation and technical excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas at random moments.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up to encourage faster decision-making.
